name: reference_day_powered
status: Rehearsal preset fitted on the CURRENT map against the 2026-11-08 Cycles beauty shots. Not accepted for the improved map.
note: Every scale below is a visual fit to reference images. None is a physical conversion from Blender watts.

pass_notes.1: Fixture type and energy balance. Spot lights (140 degree cone, inverse-square) for panels under 1 m2, AreaLight3D for larger ones; per-room ambient from fixture power replaces dynamic GI indoors; SDFGI off (it leaked sky light into rooms and received nothing from area lights); sun and sky lowered to the reference exposure.
pass_notes.2: Materials and colour. Dust layer reproduced in a shader from the per-object dust property; explicit render colours used where the Blender material had one; room light masks tightened so floor tiles and furniture are lit only by their own room, with thin door and partition panels lit from both sides; smoked hall glass; saturation 1.12 and AgX contrast 1.3 as the stand-in for Blender's AgX Punchy look; fog tested and rejected (it brightened and desaturated the distance).
pass_notes.3: Shadows, contact, reflections and bloom. Shadow maps on the three largest fixtures of each zone (panels of 0.25 m2 or more); stronger SSAO for contact shading; SSIL for local bounce; mild glow as the stand-in for the compositor bloom; room ambient scaled by each room's mean surface albedo (integrating-sphere estimate) so dark rooms get less bounce; reflection-probe intensity halved; screen emission reduced to the average luminance of mostly dark screen content.
pass_notes.4: Owner request 2026-11-11: no texture baking; match the Blender look by other means. Render-detail meshes; Blender's procedural material layers ported to run-time shaders (variation, edge wear, grime, dust, relief, screen layouts, glass, terrain).
